column3: Exact recurrence of يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا; adds the surrounding استغفار/توبة and زيادة القوة. V12 supports f01/f02, with f03 as contrast.
Channel-level day/night and covering resonance only; it does not localize the rain-dispatch route.
A contrary instance of sky-sending upon the addressee; preserves a warning-side boundary for f01 rather than positive rain support.
Near-exact sky/مدرار frame, extended by rivers, establishment, and later destruction. V12 supports f01/f02 and marks f03 contrast.
Immediate continuation: the discharge is followed by wealth, children, gardens, and rivers; its channels retain the provision and circulation readings.
Only the shared sent-messenger form; the mixed f01 link is not localized to the candidate's wording.
A sharply contrary يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُم case, showing that sending upon recipients is not intrinsically beneficent.
Immediate preceding response of flight gives the resisted-call setting for 71:11, though it adds no rain detail.
Upward authority affecting the ground supplies a contrary boundary around the sky domain; V12 also retains a mixed support reading.
Sky-water upon the addressees is tied to purification, removal, heart-binding, and firm footing, adding concrete effects of received water.
Channel-level night/day alternation is parallel evidence only, without the 71:11 discharge or provision route.
Nuh's dispatch to his people and explicit warning establish the messenger-side of f01 before the later 11:52 parallel.
Gives a staged wind-cloud-sky-rain sequence and a recipient response, adding process to the abundant discharge.
Immediate self-identification as a clear warner frames the speaker whose call precedes 71:11.
The lone V12 link is reject/contrast; the sending of the she-camel adds no reliable route to 71:11.
Another destructive sky-sending-upon case; useful as boundary evidence for the same directional frame.
Immediate sequel shifts from provision to the demanded وَقَار, retaining the local response horizon.
Sky construction supplies only broad f02 parallel evidence and is already less specific than the earlier rain cards.
Links provision from sky and earth to the single provider, contributing a nonredundant source-and-provision frame.
Generic sky-and-earth ownership; the channel resonance is not localized to the rain wording.
The sending form supports f01's messenger-as-carrier reading, but has no sky-water or abundance detail.
Light imagery does not furnish a localized route to the dispatched sky or its abundant flow.
Immediate night-and-day calling supplies the repeated-call setting in the same channel complex, not rain content itself.
Only a mixed parallel between messengers and winds; earlier messenger and rain cards cover the stronger evidence.
Cosmic sky-motion is boundary evidence about the sky, not support for its beneficial dispatch.
Immediate instruction sequence supplies the response framework leading into the forgiveness and dispatch clauses.
A vertical heaven-to-earth ordering is a broad mixed f02 parallel, without water or abundance.
A sky-water opening is a distinct, forceful water scene; it supplies a contrary boundary to 71:11's مِّدْرَارًا route.
Channel evidence concerns messenger endurance and adds no localized relation to 71:11.
A different sending-upon relation provides only a remote alternative carrier pattern for f01.
Sky rupture is V12 boundary evidence about loss of an upper cover, not a positive discharge parallel.
Immediate surah opening sends Nuh toward his people; it establishes the outward messenger movement retained in f01.
Multiple messengers are a mixed, generic f01 parallel already covered by the earlier Nuh dispatch cards.
Sky splitting supplies another boundary around the upper cover, redundant with 82:1.
Immediate public calling develops the call sequence whose response conditions 71:11.
Generic lordship over sky and earth does not localize a provision or sending route.
Cosmic dissolution is only a boundary around the stable sky domain, repeating earlier rupture cards.
Channel-level forgiveness and later recompense loosely parallels the preceding forgiveness clause but adds no 71:11 route.
V12's sky-order reading is broad support for f02, but not localized to rain, abundance, or covering's benefit.
The returning sky offers a recurrent-water pattern that can illuminate the sustained character of مِّدْرَارًا.
Immediate forgiveness-and-delay clause completes the local condition before 71:10-11 and prevents isolating the dispatch.
Denial of independent efficacy in the heavens is broad f02 evidence only.
Sky pathways give structural f02 parallel evidence, already less informative than the water cards.
Immediate preceding استغفروا clause directly supplies the condition to which 71:11 responds.
Generic ownership and return add no localized connection after stronger source/ownership cards.
A falling sky fragment is contrary boundary evidence, not positive support for the abundant discharge.
Its wealth-and-children extension resonates with 71:12's aftermath, but is indirect and channel-level.
Generic messenger identity supports f01 only at a highly redundant level.
Removal of the sky-cover is boundary evidence for f02, repeating earlier rupture cards.
Immediate refusal through ears, garments, persistence, and pride supplies the obstructed-response context for the following offer.
Generic messenger identity is redundant; the later narrative consequence is not in this candidate.
Raised sky and balance provide broad structural f02 evidence but no rain or recipient relation.
Channel-level increase after encounter weakly parallels the response and increase motif, without a 71:11 route.
Generic cosmic return does not add a localized reading after the stronger sky-source cards.
Sky opening is repeated boundary evidence rather than support for the beneficent discharge.
The closing prayer's household entry preserves a secondary channel reading, but does not clarify 71:11 itself.
Immediate continuation turns to layered heavens; V12 retains f02 evidence that an upper cover can transmit rather than merely block.
Sky-sent حُسْبَان on a garden is a contrary destructive counterpart, weaker than earlier direct boundaries.
Its channel resonance is not localized to the candidate's unexpected-book wording.
All-encompassing ownership is too generic and redundant to clarify the specific dispatch.
Bare victory language supplies no localized route to 71:11.
Broad creation and day/night alternation repeat channel-level background without the dispatch relation.
Generic messenger identity supplies only a redundant f01 parallel.
Wind as herald before mercy and purified sky-water gives a compact alternative rain-and-mercy sequence.
Channel-level destruction after failed calls offers a distant contrary outcome, not a route within 71:11.
Human messengers as carriers supports f01 generally, but is redundant after 11:25 and 71:1.
Creation-command wording has no localized lexical, channel, or V12 route to 71:11.
Channel-level increase and provision is remote and already covered more directly by 71:12.
Release language and messenger proof supply a separate f01 liberation pattern, not the sky-dispatch relation.
The word عليكم here concerns guardianship, not water, sky, or sending.
Measured creation and sky-earth ownership give only broad, redundant f02 background.
Sky-water produces fruits as provision, making the provision outcome explicit after the earlier process cards.
Sky-earth inescapability is broad authority evidence, not the beneficial release route.
Sent winds, sky-water, and drinking form an ecological transfer chain that concretizes reception from the source.
A broad kingdom-of-sky-and-earth view is too general to add beyond earlier sovereignty cards.
Sent winds connect mercy with travel and seeking bounty; this adds a secondary benefit pattern to the rain route.
Requested stones from the sky are a contrary punishment boundary, weaker and less direct than 67:17.
Layered sky formation is broad structural background, redundant with 71:15 and other sky cards.
The sending of gatherers is a coercive human counterpattern with no reliable 71:11 route.
Heralding winds before mercy provides a compressed, now redundant ecological parallel.
Generic exalted ownership adds no localized explanatory value.
Sky-sent punishment after altered speech is contrary boundary evidence, with no rain/provision detail.
Release of a people is a different sending form and adds no dependable link to 71:11.
A messenger descending from the sky weakly supports f01's vertical sending pattern, not the water clause.
Seven heavens under one lord supply broad f02 structure, redundant after 71:15.
Heralding winds, heavy clouds, water, fruits, and revival give the fullest nonidentical ecological chain for 71:11.
The question about responses to messengers contributes a remote f01 reception/accountability parallel.
A provision explicitly descending from the sky adds a distinct recipient-and-rizq instance, though later and less exact.
The generic creation question lacks a localized discharge, water, or recipient route.
Bare messenger identity is a highly redundant f01 parallel.
Timed messengers add no localized insight into the sky-water dispatch.
Sky splitting with clouds is boundary evidence about the upper cover, not a positive water route.
Blessed sky-water leading to gardens and harvest reinforces the productive outcome, but is redundant after 7:57 and 2:22.
A barren wind is a contrary carrier pattern that marks the limit of the mercy/provision sequence.
Possible sky-fall and ground-collapse are broad contrary boundary evidence, already well represented.
Closing cosmic ownership is fully generic and redundant.
Sky adornment offers no localized relation to 71:11.
Sky becoming gates is repeated boundary evidence about the upper cover.
Greeting and patience have no localized link to the candidate or its channels.
The denial of a sent guardianship role gives only a remote, negative f01 parallel.
A sky-borne rainstorm with darkness, thunder, and lightning is a contrary atmospheric frame for the sky's descent.
Sky-water revives the earth and disperses living beings, adding a broad life-and-provision outcome for the descent.
Water sent down from the sky unfolds through vegetation, grain, gardens, and fruit; it is a major omitted productive chain.
Sky-water makes terrestrial growth flourish before its reversal, preserving a secondary transience boundary around abundance.
Water sent from the sky fills valleys by measure and produces flowing excess, closely extending the discharge-and-flow dimension.
Sky-water followed by fruits, ships, rivers, and ordered benefit gives a substantial provision sequence parallel to 71:11-12.
Sky-water supplies both drink and pasture, adding direct recipient use and growth from a single descent.
Sky-water revives dead earth, retaining the life-restoring outcome while adding less detail than the stronger productive chains.
The likeness based on sky-water and fading growth supplies a transience boundary, not positive support for the offer in 71:11.
Sky-water is followed by paired plant growth; this is a direct omitted sky-to-provision route.
Sky-water activates and grows the earth in diverse pairs, adding a life-process parallel after the stronger rain cards.
Sky-water turns the earth green, a concise productive outcome that is redundant but still directly relevant.
Water sent down from the sky in a measure and settled in the earth adds storage and controlled quantity to the descent.
The immediate gardens, palms, vines, fruits, and food after 23:18 extend its omitted provision aftermath.
Hail sent down from the sky is a distinct contrary precipitation case, delimiting any automatic positive reading of descent.
The water of 25:48 is applied to reviving dead land and giving drink to creatures, completing a direct omitted benefit sequence.
Sky-water brings forth gardens of delight, closely linking descent with cultivated abundance.
The sky-water question and revived earth provide a compact source-and-life parallel, though less developed than earlier cards.
Fear and hope accompany the sky-water that revives the earth, preserving a dual affective frame for precipitation.
Sky-water produces every noble pair, adding a productive outcome but largely repeating the stronger agricultural chains.
Water is driven to barren land for crops eaten by people and livestock, adding directed distribution and recipients.
Winds raise clouds and their water revives dead land, supplying a second wind-cloud-life process alongside 30:48.
Sky-water enters springs and produces varied crops, then change; it adds a full controlled-water and provision sequence.
Sky-water stirs and swells dead earth, retaining a direct revival outcome in compressed form.
Rain is sent after despair and mercy is spread, providing an important explicit mercy-side counterpart to 71:11.
Measured sky-water revives dead land and marks a patterned emergence, closely matching the controlled abundant-dispatch theme.
Sky-water revives the earth and the winds are turned, adding a broad signs-and-distribution frame.
The placement of رزق in the sky supplies a direct provision-domain link, though it does not itself state the water route.
The drinking-water question is a reflective source boundary; it lacks the explicit 71:11 dispatch and abundance syntax.
The threatened loss of accessible water sharpens the dependence implied by a sky-supplied flow, as a contrary boundary.
Abundant pouring water from the clouds is a major omitted parallel to مِّدْرَارًا and its productive sequel.
Water is poured abundantly before earth's opening and food growth, giving a compact, highly relevant discharge-to-provision chain.
